e96a7b3ddee5e46f7481b81e6a3c459b610294ea: Arnoldstein – Dreiländereck is a low-key, modestly sized resort — 13.5 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where you come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Arnoldstein – Dreiländereck's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. The moderate altitude of Arnoldstein – Dreiländereck — base at 680 m, summit at 1552 m — makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before you leave is strongly recommended. The day lift pass at €49 places Arnoldstein – Dreiländereck among the intermediate resorts on budget — neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short: Arnoldstein – Dreiländereck doesn't rival the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It is an honest destination, often underestimated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
